subject: MAP pre-kickoff: ownership matrix & draft timeline for Acme Health
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP pre-kickoff: ownership matrix & draft timeline for Acme Health

Team —

Quick context: Acme Health wants to run a 6–8 week evaluation focused on throughput & latency for their chat workflows, with a commercial close target this quarter. I attached a working MAP and the evaluation plan so we can align internal owners before the customer kickoff.

Key objectives in the draft MAP:
- Confirm SMEs (security, procurement, CS enablement).
- Agree on sample prompts, traffic shapes, and success criteria in the eval plan.
- Milestones: POC start (2027-04-11), mid-eval review (2027-05-09), decision/close target (2027-06-15).

Ask: please review the ownership column and the timeline, and call out any changes by EOD Tuesday. I'm proposing a quick pre-kickoff sync to finalize RACI on Thu Mar 24 10:00 AM PT (30 min).

Attachments (stubs): MAP_draft_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval_plan_v1.md (markdown)

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE (Deal Lead)
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP pre-kickoff: ownership matrix & draft timeline for Acme Health

Thanks Olga — reviewed quickly and a few suggestions below. I included inline notes and a short summary of RACI changes.

On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 9:15 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick context: Acme Health wants to run a 6–8 week evaluation ...
> 
> Attachments (stubs): MAP_draft_v0.3.xlsx, eval_plan_v1.md

My recommended RACI updates (high level):
- Customer success lead: marissa_cole — owns enablement checklist, POC runbook, and mid-eval health check.
- Sales AE: ben_carter — owns commercial terms, discounts, and procurement touchpoints.
- Solutions Engineering: aditya_rao — owns test harness, sample prompt set, and integration plan.
- Deal Lead: olga_petrov — overall timeline, stakeholder escalations, exec syncs.
- Legal review & contract: suggest adding neha_kapoor as owner for SOW/contract approvals (we'll need her sign-off for any non-standard terms).

Timeline note: the POC start date is fine, but if the customer requests production-like traffic we should plan an additional week for instrumentation. Suggest we keep the close target conservative at 2027-06-15 but be ready to move earlier if the mid-eval goes well.

I'll mark up MAP_draft_v0.3 and send comments in Drive this afternoon. I can take the first pass on the enablement checklist for the kickoff if helpful.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
